components.name: Mozzarella
components.note: A generous layer of mozzarella adds mild, creamy flavour and a stretchy texture, with a golden, bubbling finish.

taste:
This is a crisp, garlic-led pizza bread with a generous mozzarella topping, giving it a clear contrast between crunchy base and soft cheese. Sharp garlic supplies the stronger flavour, while the mild, creamy mozzarella rounds it out. Herbs are part of the bread, but the garlic and cheese are the main features described. The topping is baked until golden and bubbling, rather than simply added to the finished bread.

Served piping hot from the oven, it has the stretchy cheese texture that makes this version distinct from plain garlic pizza bread. Its richness suits sharing as a starter or accompanying a lighter salad, rather than choosing it for a restrained side.
